authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.3 classifies "the values of the properties percent and per-mille" as passive, so this sub-picture has no active character and its mantissa "must contain at least one character that is either an optional digit character or a member of the decimal digit family" is violated — D3085. jsonata-js 2.2.2 answers D3086, which needs an active character on both sides of a passive one (jsntrs-g0f).
